channel.title: Wrong Numbers — defect notes
channel.description: LLM cost accounting and eval correctness. Each note is a defect class found and fixed in production libraries.

item.title: Why your Claude bill is higher than your dashboard
item.description: Four causes of under-reported LLM spend, ranked by frequency, and the ten-minute reconciliation that identifies which one is yours.

item.title: Anthropic cache tokens are not in total_tokens
item.description: cache_read_input_tokens sits outside input_tokens; libraries that sum input and output under-report every cached request.

item.title: OpenAI prompt_tokens vs Anthropic input_tokens
item.description: One is inclusive of cached tokens, the other exclusive. Adapters that treat them as interchangeable are wrong in one direction or the other.

item.title: Streaming message_delta erases accumulated token usage
item.description: Assigning the final delta instead of accumulating wipes the input side, including cache reads. Streamed calls under-report; non-streamed are fine.
